routes.summary: E25 Entry form: measurements with previous values and any saved assessment
notes: `previous` is the latest value dated before `date` (BR-REC-81). Durations are seconds.

routes.summary: E26 Save an assessment (creates, or edits the one for member + type + date)
notes: Upsert: always 200; `created` says whether a new assessment was made. `value: null` removes a saved value; at most 60 values.

routes.summary: E27 A member's assessments, newest first
notes: Sorted by date then id; only `sortDir` is selectable (default `desc`).

routes.summary: E28 One assessment with its values
E29 Move an assessment's date or mark it estimated
notes: Unknown fields rejected; at least one field. Moving the date moves its values.

routes.summary: E30 Delete an assessment with its values
notes: The one hard delete besides sign-ins and idempotency keys (BR-REC-165).

routes.summary: E01 Sign in with the shared login
notes: Sets two cookies (httpOnly, Secure in production, SameSite=Lax, Path=/): `access_token` (JWT, Max-Age 15 min) and `refresh_token` (Max-Age 7 days when `remember`, a browser-session cookie when not).
`remember: false`: the server ends the sign-in after 12 hours (`SESSION_SHORT_TTL_SECONDS`).
Unknown username and wrong password give the same 401 INVALID_CREDENTIALS. The 5th wrong try in 15 minutes is still 401; the 6th is 429.
429 LOGIN_LOCKED: one lock for the whole login, 15 minutes, never extended by tries; `details.retryAfterSeconds` (>= 1) and a `Retry-After` header in seconds. Even the right password is refused.
429 RATE_LIMITED: 10 requests a minute per network address (after body validation, before the lock check).
A write needs an `Origin` header equal to the app address, else 403 CSRF_ORIGIN (BR-REC-37).

routes.summary: E02 Refresh the sign-in (rotates the refresh cookie)
notes: Reads the `refresh_token` cookie; no body. Works while the login is locked (BR-REC-171).
200 sets both cookies again, as E01 (a new access token and a new refresh token); `expiresAt` is when the sign-in ends if unused.
A replaced refresh token used within 60 s of its replacement (two tabs at once) gets 200 with a new `access_token` cookie only: no second rotation and no `refresh_token` cookie (BR-REC-32).
401 SESSION_EXPIRED: no, unknown, expired or revoked token, or a replaced token used after its 60 s grace (the sign-in is then revoked).
429 RATE_LIMITED: 30 requests a minute per network address.
A write needs an `Origin` header equal to the app address, else 403 CSRF_ORIGIN (BR-REC-37).

routes.summary: E03 Sign out this device
notes: Clears both cookies (Max-Age=0, Path=/) and ends this device's sign-in. Public: it must work with an expired access token.
Always 200, also when there is no sign-in to end.
A write needs an `Origin` header equal to the app address, else 403 CSRF_ORIGIN (BR-REC-37).

routes.summary: E04 Sign out every device (this one too)
notes: Ends every active sign-in, this one too, and clears both cookies. `signedOut` counts the sign-ins ended.
Other devices lose access within 15 minutes (access tokens are checked by signature only, BR-REC-33); their refresh fails at once.
A write needs an `Origin` header equal to the app address, else 403 CSRF_ORIGIN (BR-REC-37).

routes.summary: E05 The signed-in account
notes: Does not check whether the sign-in was revoked (signature only, BR-REC-33); `remember` and `expiresAt` come from the session row of the token's `sid`.

routes.summary: E06 Change the password (other devices are signed out)
notes: `newPassword` must be 8-128 characters, else 400 VALIDATION_ERROR on `newPassword` (BR-REC-02, 27).
A wrong current password is 400, never 401: a 401 makes the app try a refresh and sign out.
A wrong current password counts toward the lock; while locked: 429 LOGIN_LOCKED as E01 (`details.retryAfterSeconds`, `Retry-After`).
Every other sign-in is revoked; this one stays and its cookies do not change.
A write needs an `Origin` header equal to the app address, else 403 CSRF_ORIGIN (BR-REC-37).

routes.summary: E31 Who is overdue or due soon (Home and Due list)
notes: One row per member per assessment. Order: Assess soon first, then most days overdue, then soonest due, then name (BR-REC-97). Archived and expired members are excluded (BR-REC-17).

routes.summary: E32 One member's due status per assessment
notes: A plain array, not paginated: one entry per turned-on assessment (bounded by the catalog).

routes.summary: E33 Assess soon (flag) or Remind me later (snooze)
notes: Body `{ action: 'flag' }` or `{ action: 'snooze', until: 'YYYY-MM-DD' }`. `until` is after today and at most 90 days ahead. The two replace each other.

routes.summary: E34 Clear Assess soon or Remind me later
Liveness and database connectivity probe
notes: 503 is returned when the database is unreachable (db: 'down').

routes.summary: E16 Find and list members
notes: `q` (2+ characters) matches name, phone or email; `phone` matches the last 10 digits.
Without `status`, archived members are left out; `status=any` includes them.

routes.summary: E17 Add a member with the first membership period
notes: Requires header `Idempotency-Key: <uuid>` (BR-REC-156): a repeat with the same key within 48 h returns the first answer; the same key with a different body is 422 IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED; a duplicate that arrives while the first is still running waits up to 10 s, then gets 429 RATE_LIMITED. Only a successful (2xx) answer is stored: a failed request frees its key.

routes.summary: E18 One member with membership and periods
E19 Edit a member (archived members too)
notes: Unknown fields rejected; at least one field.

routes.summary: E20 Archive a member
E21 Restore an archived member
E22 Add a membership period (renew)
notes: Requires header `Idempotency-Key: <uuid>` (BR-REC-156): a repeat with the same key within 48 h returns the first answer; the same key with a different body is 422 IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED; a duplicate that arrives while the first is still running waits up to 10 s, then gets 429 RATE_LIMITED. Only a successful (2xx) answer is stored: a failed request frees its key.
`memberRestored` is true when the period covers today and the member was archived (BR-REC-58).

routes.summary: E23 Edit a membership period
notes: Unknown fields rejected; at least one field. Periods are never deleted.

routes.summary: E24 Memberships ending soon or recently ended
notes: `status=expiring`: soonest end first. `status=expired`: ended in the last 30 days, most recent first. Archived members are never listed (BR-REC-53).

routes.summary: E35 A member's report card
E36 Gym-wide progress for one measurement
notes: 404 when `metricId` does not exist. Only members with 2+ readings count; `notCounted` says how many were left out.

routes.summary: E37 Leaderboard for one measurement and sex
notes: Ranked by latest value, best first by direction; equal values share a rank. 400 NO_DIRECTION for a measurement with no better direction.

routes.summary: E38 Active members by plan
E39 CSV export (members, memberships or measurements)
notes: Not JSON: the 200 body is CSV text (`text/csv; charset=utf-8`, UTF-8 with BOM, streamed), a documented exception to the envelope. `file` is one of members.csv, memberships.csv, measurements.csv; anything else is 404 NOT_FOUND.

routes.summary: E07 Gym settings
notes: Sends an `ETag`; a matching `If-None-Match` gets 304 with no body (BR-REC-160).

routes.summary: E08 Change gym settings
notes: Any of the settings; unknown fields rejected; at least one field.

`gymName` is trimmed first, then 2-60 characters. `timezone` must be an IANA name the server knows, e.g. Asia/Kolkata; unknown names and offsets such as +05:30 are 400 VALIDATION_ERROR (not visible in the schema). Lead days are whole numbers within their range (C1).

routes.summary: E09 Assessment catalog (assessments with their measurements)
notes: Ordered by setup order (`sortOrder`), measurements likewise.

Without `includeInactive=true`, off assessments and off measurements are left out. With it, all are returned, each with its own `isActive`. Turning an assessment off does not change its measurements' own `isActive`; it hides them while it is off (C5).
`hasValues`: a measurement has at least one stored value; an assessment has one in any of its measurements (C6).
Sends an `ETag`; a matching `If-None-Match` gets 304 with no body (BR-REC-160).

routes.summary: E10 Add an assessment
notes: `name` is trimmed first, then must be 2-40 characters; NAME_TAKEN compares trimmed names ignoring case (C2).
Added last, On, with no measurements (C7).

routes.summary: E12 Set the order of the assessments
notes: `typeIds` lists every assessment once each, in the new order.
At least one id, no id twice (400 VALIDATION_ERROR). Every item of the set, on and off, must be listed once; any missing, extra or foreign id is 400 VALIDATION_ERROR (C7).

routes.summary: E11 Change or turn off an assessment
notes: Unknown fields rejected; at least one field.
`name` is trimmed first, then must be 2-40 characters; NAME_TAKEN compares trimmed names ignoring case (C2).
`isActive: false` hides the assessment and its measurements without changing their own `isActive` (C5).
The answer lists all of the assessment's measurements, on and off, in setup order, each with its own `isActive`; `includeInactive` belongs to E09 only.

routes.summary: E13 Add a measurement to an assessment
notes: `name` is unique inside the assessment (on and off ones), compared trimmed and ignoring case (C2).

400 VALIDATION_ERROR: `plausibleMin` must be below `plausibleMax` when both are numbers (issue path `plausibleMin`); `intervalCount` + `intervalUnit` both set or both null (path `intervalCount`); `tableGroup` + `tablePart` both set or both null (path `tableGroup`). `tableGroup` is trimmed first, then 2-40 characters (C2).
A duration (Time) measurement always gets unit `min:sec` and 0 decimals, whatever the request sends; its check range is in seconds (C3).
Added last and On. Defaults when omitted: unit empty, decimals 1 (0 for a duration), no check range, no own repeat, no report-table place.

routes.summary: E15 Set the order of an assessment's measurements
notes: `metricIds` lists every measurement of the assessment once each, in the new order.
At least one id, no id twice (400 VALIDATION_ERROR). Every item of the set, on and off, must be listed once; any missing, extra or foreign id is 400 VALIDATION_ERROR (C7).

routes.summary: E14 Change or turn off a measurement
notes: Unknown fields rejected; at least one field.
`name` is unique inside its assessment (on and off ones), compared trimmed and ignoring case (C2).

400 VALIDATION_ERROR: `plausibleMin` must be below `plausibleMax` when both are numbers (issue path `plausibleMin`); `intervalCount` + `intervalUnit` both set or both null (path `intervalCount`); `tableGroup` + `tablePart` both set or both null (path `tableGroup`). `tableGroup` is trimmed first, then 2-40 characters (C2).
When only one side of a pair or of the check range is in the body, the result is checked against the stored values; a pair or range that would end up broken is 400 VALIDATION_ERROR (C8).
A duration (Time) measurement always gets unit `min:sec` and 0 decimals, whatever the request sends; its check range is in seconds (C3).
A change from Time to Number without a `unit` in the body leaves the unit empty (C3).
METRIC_LOCKED: datatype and unit cannot change once any value exists (BR-REC-11). Only a real change counts; sending the stored value again is fine (C4).

routes.summary: E40 Report one web-vitals measurement
notes: 204 with no body. The server only logs a `vitals` line (BR-REC-152).
